# sherpa-list-item

A single list row.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Menu List Item |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-list-item/sherpa-list-item.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-list-item/sherpa-list-item.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-list-item/sherpa-list-item.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-list-item/sherpa-list-item.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-list-item/sherpa-list-item.example.json) |

## When to use it

For one row in a `sherpa-list`: a label, a description, and optional icon, tick, expand and drag controls. Use `data-current` for the row the reader is on and `data-selected` for a ticked row; a row can be both.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-list><sherpa-list-item data-label="Project Alpha" data-description="Owned by design"></sherpa-list-item></sherpa-list>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-current` | boolean | `false` | current-row state |
| `data-description` | text |  | secondary text |
| `data-draggable` | boolean |  | show the drag handle |
| `data-expandable` | boolean |  | show the expand toggle |
| `data-expanded` | boolean | `false` | expanded state (the toggle reflects it) |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a leading icon glyph |
| `data-interactive` | boolean | `false` | hover + click behaviour |
| `data-label` | text |  | primary text |
| `data-selectable` | boolean |  | show a leading selection control (checkbox affordance) |
| `data-selected` | boolean | `false` | selection state (for the leading control) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disabled state |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `current` | `boolean` | read and write | reads and toggles data-current |
| `selected` | `boolean` | read and write | reads and toggles data-selected |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `item-select` | `{ label: string }` | The row was picked. |
| `item-expand` | `{ expanded: boolean }` |  |
| `selection-change` | `{ selected: boolean }` | The row's tick changed. |
| `item-drag` |  |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `control` | input | a custom selection control (else the built-in native checkbox) |
| `leading` | icon | a custom icon / avatar (in addition to the data-icon glyph) |
| `trailing` | control, badge | actions / badges |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`content`, `control`, `description`, `drag`, `expand`, `icon`, `lead`, `leading`, `row`, `title`, `trailing`
